proposed_widenings.name: passive_trigger_class_feature_family
proposed_widenings.justification: Fleet Step fires automatically on a conditioned window (bonus_action_window, excluding Step of the Wind itself). It has no explicit activation, no use_count, and no rest reset. The current ClassFeatureMechanics union contains only 'activation', which mandates activationCost + resource (UseCountResource) + resetCadence. A passive/triggered family is needed for features that fire on a turn-structure event rather than being explicitly activated.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_feature_use_at_waived_cost
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is 'grant use of Step of the Wind without expending an additional Bonus Action'. Existing ClassFeatureEffect variants (grant_extra_action, heal_hp) do not cover this — grant_extra_action grants a generic extra action, not a specific named feature at a waived cost. A new effect variant referencing a feature by id with a cost override is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after that Bonus Action

proposed_widenings.name: bonus_action_exclusion_filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger has a named-feature exclusion condition ('other than Step of the Wind'). The current surface has no filter grammar on window triggers for class features. A closed filter shape — or a ConditionedTrigger variant — is needed to represent 'bonus action, excluding named feature X'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind

notes: Fleet Step is a passive conditional rider on the bonus_action_window: whenever the monk spends their Bonus Action on anything except Step of the Wind, they also gain Step of the Wind at no additional BA cost (Focus Point cost of base Step of the Wind presumably still applies). This is a triggered passive, not an activated feature with a use count and rest reset. No ClassFeatureMechanics family supports this shape honestly. Dhall and JSON not written.
